'''Driscoll Bruhnej''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and the [[Twin/Legends|twin]] brother of [[Trey Bruhnej]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], sending Driscoll and Trey, as well as thousands of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] refugees to Alderaan's sister planet [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]].<ref name="Hostage" /> 

When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited Delaya to help the refugees, as well as recruit soldiers for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Driscoll and his brother were among an Alderaanian faction that resented Organa's involvement with the Rebellion, blaming her for their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] destruction. Their group abducted Organa then planned to turn her over to the Empire in exchange for a new planet to settle on. However, the Imperials reneged on the deal and took Organa after [[Death/Legends|killing]] her abductors. Driscol and his brother were the first to die, acting as guards to their group's hideout.<ref name="Hostage" />
